SiteSettings.title: SiteSettings
SiteSettings.description: Global Smoky Zone configuration including labels, playlist, video clips, projects, thoughts, activity logs, and photo references

labels.description: Customizable text labels across the site

playlist.description: List of curated music tracks in Smoky Zone Official Selection

projectPhotos.description: Map of project IDs to custom photo URLs

brandPhotos.description: Map of core brand photo keys to custom URLs

walkinPhoto.description: Primary Walk-In visual portrait URL or Storage download URL

MediaItem.title: MediaItem
MediaItem.description: Stored media asset metadata pointing to Firebase Storage download URLs or legacy chunked payloads

key.description: Unique key identifier for the media slot

data.description: Download URL or legacy Base64 data

downloadUrl.description: HTTPS download URL from Firebase Storage

storagePath.description: Object path inside Firebase Storage bucket

mimeType.description: MIME type of the media (image, video, audio)

isChunked.description: Whether legacy Firestore chunking was used

SystemAdminStatus.title: SystemAdminStatus
SystemAdminStatus.description: Authoritative owner verification record used by Firestore and Firebase Storage cross-service security rules

owner_email.description: Verified email of the authenticated owner account; limited to the explicit application owner allowlist

owner_uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the verified owner

lastSignedInEmail.description: Normalized email of last verified Google sign-in

lastGoogleSignIn.description: ISO timestamp of last Google sign-in

owner_uids.description: Firebase Auth UIDs for approved owner Google accounts

owner_emails.description: Approved owner emails paired by index with owner_uids

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Audit log item for studio updates
